Class SettingsWorld

java.lang.Object
greenfoot.World
SettingsWorld
public class SettingsWorld extends greenfoot.World
The SettingsWorld class is a Greenfoot World that serves as the game's configuration menu.

This world allows players to customize their game setup through two screens:

  • Screen 1: Configure the number of chefs (1-3) and starting money ($500-$5000) for both Blue and Red restaurants
  • Screen 2: Select specific chef types (Master, Cohen, Hungry, Lazy) for each restaurant based on the total count chosen
The selected settings are stored as variables and passed to RestaurantWorld when the game starts.
